safetyTranslation.sourceDirection: Use culturally recognizable uniform-fantasy energy from authority, rescue, aviation, care, education and specialty-performance archetypes.
safetyTranslation.publicSafeBoundary: No upskirt framing, no explicit fetish work, no bondage, no restraint, no mummification, no non-consensual camera angles, no nudity and no exposed intimate areas.
safetyTranslation.allowedVisualPhilosophy: Short tailored hemlines, bold opaque couture, glossy coated textiles, lace or guipure over solid backing, flirtatious relationship geometry, adult love-triangle-plus-ECE square connection, controlled glimpses of shoulders, backs, waistlines and leg lines, complete footwear, clean faces and hands.

attractionMap.commandTravel: Pilots and flight attendants: travel, composure, presentation, command and route-light aesthetics.
attractionMap.rescueHeroism: Firefighters, EMTs and rescue responders: bravery, urgency, competence, fitness and protective action.
attractionMap.medicalCare: Doctors, surgeons and nurses: intelligence, care, steadiness, precision and clinical authority.
attractionMap.disciplineAuthority: Police and military-inspired civic guardians: discipline, structured uniforms and responsibility, abstracted without real insignia or weapons.
attractionMap.educationMentorship: Teachers and educators: warmth, intelligence, mentorship and controlled academy styling without classroom power imbalance.
attractionMap.fitnessDrive: Personal trainers and athletes: health, discipline, movement and confident posture.
attractionMap.ambitionIntellect: Entrepreneurs, lawyers and business leaders: ambition, strategy, polished tailoring and decision-room energy.
attractionMap.handsOnCraft: Builders and trades-inspired craft crews: competence, tools-as-design, practical skill and physical work, with all equipment harmless and decorative.

castContract: Exactly four clearly adult fictional women in every scene: Radiance, Ellie, Alia and AI ECE. PAWS appears only when explicitly assigned by the batch plan.
